• Chemically modified gas - CO2 in the form of HCO3-.

questions.explanation:
Hemoglobin has 4 subunits each of which has heme molecule and polypeptide chain. Ferrous iron in heme binds to a molecule of O2. Hence 1 hemoglobin binds to 4 molecules of O2.

• Hemoglobin is a protein made up of four subunits.
• Each of the four iron atoms in hemoglobin can reversibly bind one O2. The iron stays in the ferrous state so that the reaction is oxygenation (not oxidation).

HDF is the fetal variant of hemoglobin.

The B chains of adult hemoglobin (hemoglobin A) are replaced by y chains in HbF. This

questions.question: The level of 2,3-DPG is decreased in______
questions.explanation:
The level of 2,3-DPG is decreased in acidosis.

2,3-DPG is produced from 3-phosphoglycerate which is a product of glycolysis. Acidosis inhibits red cell glycolysis, which decreases the levels of 2,3-DPG.

questions.subject: Physiology
questions.question: High affinity of HbF to O2 is due to_____
questions.explanation:
Increased affinity of HbF to O2 is due to decreased affinity of y chains of HbF to 2,3DPG.
HDF is the fetal variant of hemoglobin.

The B chains of adult hemoglobin (hemoglobin A) are replaced by y chains in HbF. This
modification results in increased affinity of hemoglobin for O02, a left shift of the O2-hemoglobin
dissociation curve, and decreased P50.

The mechanism of the left shift is based on the binding of 2,3-DPG. 2,3-DPG does not bind as
avidly to the y chains of HbF as it binds to the f chains of hemoglobin A. When less 2,3-DPG is
bound, the affinity for O2 increases and facilitates the movement of O2 from the mother to the
fetus.

This increased affinity is beneficial to the fetus, whose PaO2 is low (approximately 40 mm Hg).
